gen-tourney-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans reads tall and open, its curves never crowding. Under Tourney's stretched, bulky capitals it gives the eye a quiet place to settle, so a long passage moves along without any strain.
gen-tourney-gf-matangi: Tourney's strokes are all cut to one width, stretched wide by its tracking. Matangi's rounded, twine-like sans keeps a longer passage soft and hefty, easy to follow from line to line.
gen-tourney-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro opens its curves with a welcoming gap and holds its lines to a gentle, uniform thickness. Maven Pro against Tourney's loud, stretched display letters gives the pair its strongest quality: a shout followed by a soft-spoken sans-serif.
gen-tourney-gf-michroma: Wide, sporty and unmistakably engineered. Michroma gives every letter generous room and a tall body, so a longer passage in this plain sans unrolls slowly, beneath Tourney's heavy, outline-like strokes.
gen-tourney-gf-miriam-libre: Tourney stretches its bulky letters wide, every stroke cut to a single width. And Miriam Libre follows with a wire-thin line and sturdy, tall lowercase, so the heading hits hard and the text stays friendly.
gen-tourney-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Tourney stamps out wide-tracked, bulky letters with every stroke cut to a single width, loud and athletic. Mochiy Pop P One answers with generous spacing and a sizable lowercase, which makes the pair feel playful.
gen-tourney-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline has big lowercase and breathing bowls. Beside Tourney's stretched display letters, a slightly larger size for this plain sans would let those round, uniform curves hold their own.
gen-tourney-gf-mozilla-headline: Chunky letters meet a friendly sibling. Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, and that lively looseness is the pair's strongest quality against Tourney's rigid, constant-width strokes.
gen-tourney-gf-mozilla-text: Tourney draws everything with the flat line of a fineliner, then stretches it wide. Mozilla Text offers tall lowercase with flaring terminals, a plain sans that looks sturdy under such a rigid heading.
gen-tourney-gf-nata-sans: Tourney's single constant stroke gets stretched wide, with bulky small letters. Nata Sans sets a large central band against it, its open-mouthed curves steady like technical-pen lines, which is what makes the pair so legible.
